caption: אמת חסד ודעת אלוהים

caption: מים לחם ובגדים חדשים

caption: בתים וחומות
en: ancient stone houses with a strong wall and a gate in a quiet town, no people, no text (Houses, walls and gates)

caption: להעניש אותו במכות
en: a heavy wooden rod leaning against a stone wall, no people, no text (To punish him)

en: a clean white bandage and a small clay jar of ointment on a wooden table, no people, no text (To heal him)

caption: לשכוח אותו לגמרי
en: an abandoned empty stone well in a dry field, no people, no text (To forget him)

en: men in ancient robes building a tall altar of stones on a hill, no text (Until they build an altar)

en: men in ancient robes harvesting wheat in a wide field, no text (Until the harvest ends)

en: a father standing a little way off on a hill, watching a boy who calls out and begins to run toward him, no text (Until they seek Me)
